notes: Head of s015 on *silver* rather than *pieces*: *pieces of* is the supplied completion and *silver* carries the ἀργυρ- lexeme (rules 66, 91).
The verse-opening *and* is the juncture introduced by the participle-to-finite conversion begun at 26:14 and rides with εἶπεν under rule 88 rather than being marked added.
